name: Slater Plain
point_method: Most-sunlit point in 2027 among 484 candidates on a grid within 25 km of the IAU feature (LOLA terrain, 2 m mast), refined on a 400 m grid

terrain.layout: int16 LE metres relative to the site (curvature drop included), rows south->north, cols west->east

illum.method: Sun centre / Earth centre above a 180-direction LOLA horizon (80 km), 6-hourly through 2027, 2 m observer
